in_hebrew.name: יָבֶה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Jabe is derived from the root 'yabh' which means 'to be beautiful, to be father'. Thus, Jabe can be translated as 'father of beauty'.

in_greek.name: Ιαβε
in_greek.long_meaning: In the Greek Septuagint, Jabe is transliterated as Ιαβε (Iabē), which is essentially a transliteration of the Hebrew name.

in_latin.name: Iabes
in_latin.long_meaning: In Latin, Jabe is transliterated as Iabes, which is derived from the Greek Ιαβε (Iabē).

in_english.name: Jabe
in_english.long_meaning: Jabe is the direct English transliteration of the Hebrew, Greek, and Latin names.
